mods.name: quark-lm-head
mods.switch_null_why: vLLM has no switch for it: applied = on, patch -R -p1 = stock

evidence.run: BoltBeam docs/evidence/mtp-27b-rtx5090-r9700-20261027 (README.md and r9700/sources.md: the author's recorded results; no raw run files were kept)
evidence.numbers: with a checkpoint whose config excludes lm_head nothing changes by construction (not run). With the int4-head copy from tools/quark_lm_head_int4.py: 98.0% top-1 agreement with the bf16 head, perplexity 1.228 -> 1.242; that is the checkpoint's effect, and no agreement gate was run

gain.conditions: it only lets vLLM load a checkpoint whose lm_head is quantized. The int4-head checkpoint it enables (tools/quark_lm_head_int4.py): lm_head 2.54 -> 0.66 GB; decode 56.1 -> 61.2 tok/s without MTP, 92.3 -> 115.5 at MTP k=2 (split-kv-verify on in both), vs the bf16 head; 98.0% top-1 agreement, perplexity 1.228 -> 1.242 (2 x R9700, TP=2, a dense model with an MTP head)
